import numpy as np,json,time,os
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
ROOT='/app/runs'
class Control:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot(); self.spec=self.r.spec(); self.obs=self.r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'); self.seq=len([p for p in os.listdir(ROOT) if p.isdigit()]);self.save('observe')
 def save(self,note):
  self.path=f'{ROOT}/{self.seq:03d}';self.obs.save(self.path);self.seq+=1
  p=np.array(self.obs.meta['proprio']['now']);self.q=p[4:11];self.eef=p[26:29];self.p=p
  print('OBS',self.path,note,'eef',self.eef.round(5).tolist(),'q',self.q.round(5).tolist(),'fingers',p[11:13].round(5).tolist(),'remaining',self.obs.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
  out=Image.new('RGB',(640,520));d=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
  for i,(c,im) in enumerate(self.obs.last.items()):
   out.paste(Image.fromarray(im),((i%2)*320,(i//2)*260));d.text(((i%2)*320,(i//2)*260+240),c)
  out.save(ROOT+'/latest.png')
  np.savez('/app/output/state.npz',q=self.q,eef=self.eef,p=self.p)
 def movej(self,q,seconds=1.0,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1,note='move'):
  n=max(1,int(seconds/.05)); a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=np.linspace(self.q,q,n);a[:,7]=self.p[36] if grip is None else grip
  if base is not None:a[:,8:11]=base
  a[:,11]=torso;a[:,12]=mode
  self.obs=self.r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=list(self.spec['cameras']),include_depth=True,video='none',note=note);self.save(note)
 def point(self,cam,u,v):
  dep=self.obs.depth[cam];dep=dep[-1] if dep.ndim==3 else dep
  z=float(dep[int(v),int(u)]);m=self.obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(m['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(m['cam2world_gl']);p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1]);return (T@p)[:3]

def fk(q):
 a=[0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088];d=[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,0];al=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2];T=np.eye(4)
 for qi,ai,di,ali in zip(q,a,d,al):
  ct,st=np.cos(qi),np.sin(qi);ca,sa=np.cos(ali),np.sin(ali)
  T=T@np.array([[ct,-st,0,ai],[st*ca,ct*ca,-sa,-di*sa],[st*sa,ct*sa,ca,di*ca],[0,0,0,1]])
 return T

def fit(samples):
 def residual(x):
  R=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();t=x[3:6];off=x[6:9]
  return np.concatenate([R@(fk(s['q'])[:3,3]+fk(s['q'])[:3,:3]@off)+t-np.array(s['eef']) for s in samples])
 x0=np.r_[0,0,0,3.3,-1.1,1,0,0,.21]
 sol=least_squares(residual,x0,max_nfev=5000)
 print('FIT',sol.x,'error',np.linalg.norm(sol.fun),flush=True);np.save('/app/output/kin.npy',sol.x);return sol.x

class Kin:
 def __init__(self):
  x=np.load('/app/output/kin.npy'); self.R=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();self.t=x[3:6];self.off=x[6:9]
 def pose(self,q):
  T=fk(q);return self.R@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@self.off)+self.t,self.R@T[:3,:3]
 def ik(self,pos,q0,R=None):
  def fun(q):
   p,r=self.pose(q);err=list((p-pos)*10)
   if R is not None:err.extend(Rotation.from_matrix(R@r.T).as_rotvec()*1.2)
   err.extend((q-q0)*.01);return np.array(err)
  b=([-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-.0175,-2.8973],[2.8973,1.7628,2.8973,-.0698,2.8973,3.7525,2.8973])
  s=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,np.array(b[0])+1e-5,np.array(b[1])-1e-5),bounds=b,max_nfev=300)
  print('IK err',np.linalg.norm(self.pose(s.x)[0]-pos),flush=True);return s.x
PY
